title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Social and Community Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a social or community app: a feed that handles media, follows and messages, the moderation tools Apple requires, and push that brings people back.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 74 out of 80, because it builds the feed, follows, messages, Apple sign-in, push, and in-app AI on one managed database. FlutterFlow is second at 51.


Guideline 1.2 requires content filtering, a way to report offensive content with timely responses, the ability to block abusive users, and published contact information.


Apple's guideline 1.2 says apps used primarily for random or anonymous chat, Chatroulette-style experiences, or hot-or-not voting do not belong on the App Store and may be removed.


Blink's own mobile documentation flags that iOS apps offering social logins need it, and Blink ships Apple sign-in alongside email and Google.


Yes. Blink apps can call 74 text models plus image models, so posts and photos can be screened before they show in a feed, with no API keys.
